dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: People in Sumeru seem to take divination and fortune-telling pretty seriously.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: For starters, there's astrology, although only the scholars get to practice that. But ordinary citizens have their ways, too. They can do divinations with just a cup of coffee!

choices.text: It's the nation of wisdom after all...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon heard that they can tell your fate just by looking at the bottom of a finished cup of coffee...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sounds way easier than climbing to the top of a tower and staring at the stars all night!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Are you interested in learning your fate, too?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah... although, Paimon's really more interested in finding out what the coffee tastes like.

choices.text: It seems like people have an insatiable curiosity to learn about everything, including their own future.
